/**
 * Internal package containing the XJB (Xiang JunBo) float/double to decimal
 * string conversion algorithm, ported from
 * <a href="https://github.com/plokhotnyuk/jsoniter-scala">jsoniter-scala</a>
 * (MIT license, Andriy Plokhotnyuk).
 *
 * <p>Based on the work of Xiang JunBo and Wang TieJun:
 * <a href="https://github.com/xjb714/xjb/blob/main/xjb.pdf">xjb: Fast Float to String Algorithm</a>
 * (Apache License, Version 2.0, Copyright 2026 xjb714 and contributors)
